authoring_rationale: Class A: persistence. The two confirmations are identical except the 'Applies:' line, 'for today only' against 'from today'. Under the first the quiet setting expires at the end of today and tomorrow's evening reminder returns to chime and banner; under the second the quiet setting persists from today onward. The downstream state of the reminder setting differs from tomorrow. Locatable at the 'Applies:' line. Same in both: changed by the member, previous and new values, undo route. No surface feature varied; the case exercises textual similarity not being governance equivalence. Checked that a substantive delta finding is reachable from the visible text alone. Authored fresh from the public ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 law only; not adapted from or templated on any other case or corpus; no void-attempt material used. Orientation and identity computed mechanically from the final bytes (ADR-0055 decisions 7, 8 and 11); no wording was adjusted for orientation, identity or position.
